They must be large and solid enough to recognize at 32px, rather than mere star-shaped dots. Wick opens his pixel eyes wide and reaches one hand toward the constructs as if seeing through them. NO cup, bowl, head halo or floating up-arrows. ONLY one full Wick and three little made shapes, no other people. Pure white #FFFFFF on TRANSPARENT background, transparent internal cuts, no gray, gradients, shading, glow, texture, lettering, numbers, logos, frame or extra decorative stars. Square 1024x1024, central 80 percent subject with clear margins. This icon means MANY-EYED DREAM: shared sight through Figments, not a generic celebration.
